package.name: pusht_drake
package.description:
Models for the Drake Push-T simulation: the pusher, the table and the pedestal under the elevated arm base, plus the model directives that assemble them.
The pusher, table and pedestal descriptions are adapted from Michaelszeng/diffusion-policy-drake (MIT; upstream authors Bernhard Paus Graesdal, Adam Wei and Abhinav Agarwal). See NOTICE.md at the repository root for the full provenance and the papers to cite.
package.author: Bernhard Paus Graesdal
